title: Microsoft and Brookfield sign 10.5 GW renewable energy framework

sources.quote: The agreement provides a pathway for Brookfield to deliver over 10.5 gigawatts of new renewable energy capacity between 2026 and 2030 in the U.S. and Europe.

explain: A framework under which Brookfield plans to build over 10.5 GW of new wind, solar and other carbon-free capacity in the U.S. and Europe in 2026-2030 for Microsoft to buy. Individual contracts and prices were not disclosed (press reports estimated about $10B, not confirmed by the companies). Plants: future Brookfield projects, not named.
